subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Place the held toothbrush lengthwise inside the box on the left, brush head left and handle right.
Pick up the toothbrush in front of the box and place it lengthwise inside with the brush head left and handle right.
Pick up the green shoe and pack it lengthwise inside the box, with its toe pointing left and heel pointing right. Leave room for the car, hammer and toothbrush.
Pack the red toy car fully inside the box beside the shoe, with the car's front pointing left. Withdraw upward from the shoe before moving to the car.
Restore the tipped box upright on its bottom, with the green shoe inside and the long edges running left to right.
Pack the hammer from the right side of the table into the free part of the box. Place it lengthwise with its head on the left and handle on the right.
Withdraw clear of the box and return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open.
